metadata.title: Why Micron Stock Didn’t Get a Leg Up From SK Hynix’s Memory Optimism<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Micron Stock Didn’t Get a Leg Up From SK Hynix’s Memory Optimism
Good news doesn’t seem to be doing much for Micron Technology lately. Still, shareholders in the memory-chip company should pay attention to the optimism coming from its Asian peers.
